facts.value: The library's own FAQ says only one papyrus from the ancient Library of Alexandria is known to remain. It is a scholar's copy of the first lines of satirical wisdom poems.
facts.quote: only one remaining papyrus from the ancient Library that is a copy in which an ancient scholar copied the first lines of satirical wisdom poems
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://www.bibalex.org/en/page/FAQ' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'only one remaining papyrus from the ancient Library'

facts.value: In 2002 the Internet Archive signed an agreement making the Bibliotheca Alexandrina a backup of its web archive, with two mirror sites.
facts.quote: signed an agreement with the BA in 2002 to render the latter a backup of the original
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://www.bibalex.org/en/project/details?documentid=283' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'signed an agreement with the BA in 2002 to render the latter a backup of the original'

facts.value: The Antiquities Museum shows objects dug up on the library's own building site. The library says few museums display finds from the very place they stand on.
facts.quote: displays artifacts discovered at the selfsame location of the museum
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://www.bibalex.org/en/center/details/antiquitiesmuseum' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'displays artifacts discovered at the selfsame location of the museum'
